title: jmap-search-types: shared query language types
description: Types for the planned JMAP search extension (JMAP-nn3i): one filter/query language for every JMAP data type, modeled on the jmap-graph query language, with our own extension capability id (decide it in nn3i; do not invent it here). The name was claimed on crates.io 2026-10-30 as an early 0.0.1 release from ~/PROJECT/jmap-name-claims/ (outside this workspace). Done when: the crate lives in this workspace as a member (Cargo.toml members + [workspace.dependencies] entry once something depends on it), follows the canonical-template rule, has tests with independent oracles, a public-api/ snapshot, a RELEASING.md layer entry, and publishes on the shared jmap-* version line (replacing 0.0.1).
